prompt: Plan a new 'webhooks' feature: store subscriptions in Postgres (workspace-scoped) + call GitHub to register the webhook. Which files, what goes in each, how to wire it.

assertions.text: Proposes the layered split modules/webhooks/{routes.ts, service.ts, repository.ts}
Routes = Zod + getContext + delegate, no DB; Service orchestrates + takes workspaceId first
Repository is the only place with Drizzle, and every where() is workspace-scoped
GitHub call via the GitHubClient interface from container.github(), NOT new OctokitGitHubClient()
New table in db/schema/*.ts + pnpm db:generate (no hand-written migration)
Shared shapes as Zod contracts in vendor/shared/contracts; register module with one line in modules/index.ts
